required_outcomes: Treats the email as valid written notice of at least two months and acknowledges it to Tom in writing with the end date of 10 December 2026.
Tells the landlord (Ben) that Tom has given notice and the end date.
Starts the move-out workflow: checkout or inventory arranged or proposed, how and where keys are returned, and the mydeposits return process.
Handles it without escalating to a human: a valid tenant notice only needs processing.
acceptable_alternatives: Noting that rent remains due up to the end date (apportioned for December if that is how the tenancy works), or asking Ben whether he wants re-letting to start.
positive_behaviours: Explains the deposit timescale fairly: returned within 10 days of the amount being agreed after checkout, with any deductions evidenced and excluding fair wear and tear.
Is warm and practical about the move (e.g. offers viewings to be arranged with his consent and notice).
red_flags: Telling Tom his notice needs the landlord's approval, or asking Ben to approve a notice that is already valid.
Escalating a routine, valid notice to a human.
prohibited_actions: Charging or mentioning a check-out, admin or early-release fee (banned under the Tenant Fees Act).
critical_failures: Telling Tom the notice is invalid or that he must stay beyond 10 December.
